plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 提供可配置的 CIDR 白名单，支持 fake-IP。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-fetch-allowlist

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 内置的 `web_fetch` 会拒绝解析到内网、保留地址段的域名，防止 SSRF 攻击。但这也会导致有内网/透明代理需求的场景下请求失败。
内置插件无法关闭、也无法配置，因此本插件提供一个白名单补丁，支持额外放行一段 CIDR（默认 Clash/mihomo 的 fake-IP 段 `198.18.0.0/15`），其余行为全部沿用内置实现。

## 安装

Plugins → Add plugin，填入：

```
https://github.com/icceey/dsh-web-fetch-allowlist
```

或：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:icceey/dsh-web-fetch-allowlist
```

管理器提示 `restart-required` 时重启或重新启用。

## 行为

- 先走内置 provider 的解析与校验；只有它抛 `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` 时，才尝试白名单。
- 命中就返回地址；不命中就把原来的错误原样抛出，错误码不变。
- 超时、大小上限、重定向、代理、NAT64、字符集等全部由内置实现处理，本插件仅在必要时介入和放行白名单。
- 内置 provider 不存在，或 DSH 升级后内部结构变化时，本插件保持安静、什么都不做。

## 配置

> 如果你是用clash/mihomo且没有调整过fakeip配置，安装后就可以使用，应该不需要调整任何配置。

```yaml
- id: web-fetch-allowlist
  name: 'dsh-web-fetch-allowlist'
  config:
    allowCidrs:
      - '198.18.0.0/15'
```

`allowCidrs` 支持 IPv4/IPv6，设置后替换默认值；无配置时读 `DSH_WEB_FETCH_ALLOW_CIDRS`（逗号分隔）。

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: VSCode 风格的工作区编辑器：文件树 + Monaco 编辑器 + 子 Agent 面板，适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vscode

VSCode-like workspace editor for DeepSeek Harness: a file tree plus a multi-tab
Monaco editor inside the conversation view, a per-session folder, a panel that
talks to a subagent, and VSCode's keybindings.

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

Fork of [`@supanexus/dsh-plugin-file-explorer`](https://github.com/supanexus/dsh-plugin-file-explorer)
(v0.1.0), retargeted at, and substantially extended for, DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. See
`PATCH-NOTES.md` for the full change log.

## Install

Install straight from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:yeduwuren20000-del/dsh-vscode"
```

Or clone and link a local checkout:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yeduwuren20000-del/dsh-vscode.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<path-to>/dsh-vscode"
```

Or by hand, in the profile's `package.json`:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-vscode": "link:<path-to>/dsh-vscode" } }
```

and add `"dsh-vscode"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. Restart the host afterwards —
the plugin list is read at boot.

## Features

- **Files** view with a center tree | editor split; the left sidebar stays the
  official workspace / conversation list
- One folder per session, holding that session's own files (extracted from the
  session log), with a `相关文件.md` index and a hardlink mirror
- Multi-tab editing, dirty marks, Ctrl/Cmd+S, Markdown source / preview toggle
- Create / rename / delete (non-empty directories are rejected)
- Monaco (CDN) with a Minimap toggle and an imported VSCode theme + colour scheme
- VSCode keys: `Ctrl+P` quick open, `Ctrl+B` tree, `Ctrl+Shift+E` focus tree,
  `Ctrl+W` close tab, `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+PageUp/Down` cycle, `Ctrl+1..9`;
  Arrow keys, `F2`, and `Delete` also work in the tree
- In narrow layouts the Explorer becomes a drawer and closes after a file opens
- A subagent seat under the editor that follows the current session's model

## Config

`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-vscode
      name: 'dsh-vscode'
      config:
        root: 'D:/work'          # change this to your own directory
        openLinksInEditor: false
```

Settings → Plugins → **dsh-vscode** hot-updates these fields.

> `root` is the tree the Explorer opens on. The bundled default in
> `cordis.patch.yml` points at the author's machine, so set it to your own
> directory after installing. A relative or empty value is not recommended —
> under the desktop host it resolves to the app install directory.

## Develop / rebuild

Editable JavaScript source is in `src/`, with its build order in
`src/parts.json`. The original TS/TSX was not preserved in this fork;
the current source was recovered from the working bundle and split into plugin
logic, styles, and vendor snapshots. Build and verify without an engine checkout:

```bash
npm run build
npm test
```

The host loads `lib/`; building regenerates both entry points. See
`src/README.md` for the source layout.

## License

MIT. Original work © SupaNexus; modifications © yeduwuren. See `LICENSE`.

plugins.description: An AI next-move advisor for DeepSeek Harness. Find a better next step, then press Tab to make it yours.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ACE

**Beyond the obvious.**

An AI next-move advisor for **DeepSeek Harness**. It reads the recent conversation and shows **one** card: it restates the thing you are answering, names the relation behind it, points at one other place that relation shows up, and ends with a checkable move. Press `Tab` to insert only that move; nothing is sent automatically.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Tests](https://github.com/Ghoscro/dsh-ace/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Ghoscro/dsh-ace/actions/workflows/test.yml)

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

![ACE Move example](docs/demo.svg)

> Rendered example, not a recording. A real screen capture replaces it before the first release.

**The difference, in one line:** autocomplete guesses what you *would* type; ACE reorders something you already know until the reaction is "right, why didn't I see that" — and shows nothing when nothing wins.

## Install

The npm name `dsh-ace` is taken by an unrelated project, so the package is scoped as `@ghoscro/dsh-ace`. Until it is published, the tarball on [Releases](https://github.com/Ghoscro/dsh-ace/releases) is the install path:

```bash
# in the DSH profile directory
pnpm add file:/absolute/path/to/ghoscro-dsh-ace-0.5.1.tgz
```

Then add `"@ghoscro/dsh-ace"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`, materialize the profile (DSH plugin page or `pnpm install`), and restart DSH. The composer row shows **✦ ACE** (**✦ 深度预测** in the Chinese UI).

Developer install (copy this directory into `sakura/packages/`) is at the end of [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). Verified host: **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**; other versions are unverified.

## What it does

Most next-message tools optimize for **what you would probably type**. ACE optimizes for **whether this move is worth sending**, and whether it lets you see the next layer yourself.

**The four-beat card:**

> You just said X → the line behind it is Y → so Z will behave the same way → try W first; if you see such-and-such, I was wrong

- **X** restates the concrete thing in your own words (usually the assistant line you are answering).
- **Y** states the relation in one human sentence: why it works or fails. At most one abstraction.
- **Z** gives one other place the same relation shows up. If it does not look alike on the surface, the card carries a separate line saying how it maps; if it cannot, this beat scores zero.
- **W** is a checkable action for today: engineers get a file or command, everyone else gets something they can see ("refresh and look whether the badge is still red").
- **Wrong if:** what result would prove the card wrong.

**Three plain lines on every card:**

- **Now:** what is happening and where it is stuck, in symptoms you can see.
- **Why:** the result this step is for, not the action.
- **After:** what you will see or get, specific enough to judge "is this what I want".

One missing line and the card is not shown. Wild mode is included: the line `Tab` inserts must be readable at the current level, not a stack of unexplained terms.

- It generates 3–5 directions internally: advance, use an existing tool, reframe, verify, clarify, constrain, close.
- It scores them for `value`, `novelty`, `worth_extra_step`, and action type. The relation beat is judged by the host, not scored by the model: a surface-alike example needs no mapping line, and a surface-unlike example with no written mapping is not shown at all.
- **Level:** the card reads the user's own messages and adapts — everyday language and one action at a time for non-engineers, shorthand and judgement for engineers. Override it with `level` in the plugin config.
- The default mode answers a specific line of the assistant's last message (`reply_to`, quoted verbatim), but picks the answer worth sending, not the smoothest one.
- It shows **one** card, with X/Y/Z/W and its falsifier.
- If nothing beats the obvious “continue”, it shows **nothing**. A quiet card is a feature.
- `Tab` inserts only W. You can edit it. ACE never sends for you.

## Demo

The card above is the intended loop:

1. The assistant asks, “run the full suite?”
2. The obvious next line is “run it”.
3. The card: X “run the full suite?” → Y the retry swallows the flake, so a full run only spreads the odds → Z upload retries and CI flaky reruns are the same mechanism → W “remove the retry and run this one case once”.
4. “Wrong if”: one clean run means the retry was not masking anything.
5. `Tab` inserts only W; you decide whether to send.

## Quick start

1. Install as above; restart DSH.
2. Open a conversation. The composer row shows **✦ ACE**; click it, or wait for the next completed turn if automatic ACE is on.
3. Press `Tab` on the card to fill the draft.

If you are migrating from `dsh-composer-predict`, read [MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md) first. Do not load both packages at once.

**A missing card is not a failure.** It means nothing beat the obvious "continue" for that turn. Silent turns are logged as `no-card`, and the score threshold can be swept offline with `npm run sweep` instead of being tuned on live chats.

## Three cases

These are examples, not a controlled benchmark. They show the kind of added value ACE is aiming for.

### 1. A test that may be hiding the bug

- **Obvious:** “Run the full suite.”
- **ACE Move:** “Remove the retry and run this one test once; compare repeated runs with and without retries; a higher failure rate would support the masking hypothesis.”
- **What it adds:** it tests the mechanism instead of increasing the sample size.
- **Risk:** the test may fail for an unrelated reason.

### 2. A cheaper implementation path

- **Obvious:** “Write a small script to batch this.”
- **ACE Move:** “Use the existing CLI’s `--json` output and pipe it; no new script to maintain.”
- **What it adds:** a smaller surface area and a faster path to the same outcome.
- **Risk:** the CLI may not expose the field you need.

### 3. A task that is drifting

- **Obvious:** “Keep polishing the current card.”
- **ACE Move:** “The card is not the bottleneck; the install step still fails on a fresh profile. Fix that before the visual polish.”
- **What it adds:** it names the real constraint and changes the order of work.
- **Risk:** the install failure may be environment-specific.

## How it works

1. The browser sends the recent transcript and the session `cwd` to the host route.
2. The host builds a bounded, read-only evidence pack from `git` (status, diff stat, last commit, a bounded diff).
3. A deterministic situation block is built from the last user goal, the assistant’s last offer, and explicit constraints. There is no separate situation-model call.
4. **One** model call returns 3–5 line-delimited JSON candidates plus a selection line.
5. The host scores and selects exactly one move. Fixed slot order is gone; `verify`/`constrain` candidates are penalized so “check again” cannot win by default.
6. If the best score is below the threshold, the plugin returns no card.
7. `Tab` fills the draft. The card’s `why`/`evidence`/`risk` are not sent with the message.

The parser scans balanced JSON objects and skips a truncated or malformed line while keeping valid earlier candidates. A bad line does not discard the whole response.

## Settings and cost

- **Modes:** `safe`, `standard`, `brainstorm`, `wild` (labelled **ACE**) are equal-status modes, not a volume dial. Each changes the prompt policy and the output budget, the card shows which mode produced it, and the settings panel switches it. No mode collapses into `safe`.
- **Cache:** the rules and the voice samples form a byte-identical head, the conversation is appended instead of re-windowed every turn, and only the volatile tail (mode, situation, evidence) changes, so the provider's automatic prefix cache can hit on most of the prompt.
- **Automatic ACE:** one ACE suggestion after each completed turn. You can turn it off in the ACE settings.
- **Pause:** stops automatic suggestions; `✦ ACE` still works on demand.
- **Text size:** one slider in the settings panel drives `--dsh-fs-w` / `--dsh-fs-meta` / `--dsh-fs-x`. The value is stored in `chrome.storage.local` when the container exposes

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 用量统计插件：侧边栏今日用量卡片、当前对话 token 数、按供应商与模型的明细、账户余额与套餐额度、余量提醒、历史用量补录。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-usage-stat · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 用量统计、账户余额与套餐监控插件 [English](README.en.md) | 中文

   

给 DSH Web GUI 与桌面客户端的 Token 用量台账、账户余额与编程套餐监控
侧边栏用量卡 · 本次对话明细 · 时间范围驱动的用量页 · 余额与套餐 · 余量提醒 · 历史补录

它把每一次模型调用的 token 用量记成一份按「本地日期 / 供应商 / 模型」分桶的账本，再把同一份数据放在三个地方显示：侧边栏左下角的用量卡、输入框下方那枚「本次对话」胶囊、设置里的「用量统计」页。除了用量，它还会查询供应商的账户余额与编程套餐剩余额度，并在余量偏低时标出提醒。 数据只有两个来源：DSH 自己的会话事件（用量）和供应商自己的接口（余额与套餐）。余额与套餐**不做任何本地估算** —— 查不到就写明原因，不猜一个数字出来。 ## 界面 > 下面是 `tools/preview.mjs` 用**插件自己的组件**渲染出来的截图，不是应用截图：把样式表逐字注入，套在一个设置对话框外壳的替身里，颜色取自正在运行的 DSH 主题变量。主题色跟随皮肤变化，这里是原生主题。 | 位置 | 形态 | |---|---| | 侧边栏左下角 | 折叠时一行「今日用量 + 总量」，点开列出各供应商与模型；余量偏低时在对应供应商前点一个红点 | | 输入框下方 | 一枚「本次对话 N tokens」胶囊，点开是这段对话自己的分供应商、分模型明细 | | 设置 → 用量统计 | 四个标签页：用量、金额、账户、设置 |

        

点开可看原尺寸

## 功能 - **用量页**：一排等宽分栏的合计（总 tokens / 输入 / 输出 / 缓存读 / 调用次数，缓存写只在窗口内真的出现过时才占一格）、按供应商与模型的明细、以及覆盖整个所选窗口的每日柱状图。顶部可切换统计范围：今天、近 7 天、近 30 天、全部，或自选起止日期。所有卡片都跟随所选范围，供应商占比条全页共用一个刻度。 - **账户页**：每个供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口合在一处 —— 余额按币种显示，套餐显示 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月窗口的已用百分比与重置时间。查不到数据的供应商折叠在卡片最下面，并写明原因（未配置 API Key、已用账号登录、非官方地址、该供应商没有提供这项数据）。 - **金额页**：把所选窗口的 token 按价目表折算成金额，范围可以选全部、某个供应商、或某个供应商下的某个模型；单日窗口还会按小时折算。没有价格的模型不会被算成 0，而是单独列出来告诉你有多少 token 没计入。 - **设置页**：用量刷新间隔、账户查询开关与间隔、余量提醒阈值、价目表，以及底部的版本号与历史补录状态。 - **余量提醒**：给余额和三个套餐窗口各设一个阈值，低于阈值时在对应供应商旁点一个红点（左下角卡片与账户页都有）。阈值填 0 表示那一项不提醒。判定发生在读取时，所以改完立刻生效。 - **历史补录**：插件只记录它运行期间的用量。首次启用时会自动把 DSH 已经保存在磁盘上的过往会话补进来；中间关过插件的话，可以在设置页手动再补一次。补录按调用发生的那一天入账，不会算成今天。 ### 柱状图的纵轴 纵轴是**相对的**：所选窗口里用量最重的那天就是满格。绝对刻度会把安静的一周压成一条看不见的线，而相对刻度让你一眼看出形状；卡片右上角会写出这个锚点（例如「最高 33.3M（10-17）」），把鼠标停在柱子上能看到当天的总量与调用次数。 选中「今天」或某个具体日期时，这张图换成**每小时**：固定 24 列，空的小时不画柱子（没有记录和用量为零是两回事），峰值同样写在卡片右上角。多日窗口仍然是按天。 ### 金额是怎么算的 按**价目表的标准价**折算，不含任何折扣、套餐或中转站的加价 —— 它是一个参考值，不是账单。内置了 DeepSeek 官方两档模型的价格，其余模型可以在设置页里按「每百万 token 的输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写」自己添一行。 内置价是官方的**空闲时段**价；DeepSeek 在北京时间工作日 9:00-12:00、14:00-18:00 按两倍计费，周末与中国法定节假日全天按空闲价。插件按每次调用发生的时刻判断，所以同一个窗口里的高峰时段和空闲时段各按各的价算。 价格可以**带生效日期**：涨价就再加一行、填上新价生效的那天，旧价仍然管着它生效的那段历史。生效日期留空表示从最早算起。 改价格会**立刻改变它生效范围内所有已记录调用**的金额：金额是读取时按当前价目表算出来的，不写进账本，所以纠正一个价格就纠正了那段历史，而不是只影响以后。 内置价目表和节假日表会**自动更新**：每天读一次 DeepSeek 官方定价页，每月读一次节假日表，结果缓存在本机。读不到、或者页面改了版式认不出来，就继续用上一次拿到的（从没拿到过就用随插件内置的那份），不会因此把金额算错。 缓存写没有单独给价时按输入价计。没有价格的模型不参与合计，只报告「另有 N 个模型未定价，X tokens 未计入」—— 把未知价格当成 0 会让合计看起来像免费的，那比不给数字更糟。 ## 安装 要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高，Web GUI 与官方桌面客户端都可以。 从 GitHub 安装： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-usage-stat.git ``` 从本地克隆安装（源码即产物，改完刷新页面就生效，适合自己改）： ```bash git clone https://github.com/SereneJi/dsh-usage-stat.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-usage-stat ``` `--profile` 填你在用的 profile 名（桌面客户端是 `desktop`，`dsh web` 一般是 `web`）。 宿主端改动需要重启一次 DSH；此后的界面改动刷新页面即可。设置入口在 **设置 → 用量统计**。 卸载： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-usage-stat ``` ## 配置 设置页里的每一项都对应 `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/config.json` 里的一个键（`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`）。 | 键 | 默认 | 含义 | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后不记账、不探测、界面消失 | | `pollIntervalSec` | `60` | 界面刷新用量的间隔（5–600 秒） | | `probeEnabled` | `true` | 是否查询供应商余额与套餐 | | `probeIntervalSec` | `300` | 余额与套餐的查询间隔（60–3600 秒） | | `alertEnabled` | `true` | 余量提醒总开关 | | `alertBalanceBelow` | `0` | 余额低于这个金额时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindow5h` | `0` | 5 小时窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindowWeek` | `0` | 本周窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `alertWindowMonth` | `0` | 本月窗口剩余低于这个百分比时提醒；`0` 表示不提醒 | | `prices` | DeepSeek 官方两档（空闲价） | 价目表；键是模型名，值是每百万 token 的 `input` / `output` / `cacheRead` / `cacheWrite`（CNY）。同一个模型可以给多行，每行带一个 `from` 生效日期 | 价目表也可以直接写在配置文件里，格式与设置页里的文本一致： ```json "prices": { "deepseek-flash": { "input": 2, "output": 8, "cacheRead": 0.04, "cacheWrite": 2 } } ``` `deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash` 这类带版本或后缀的名字会自动归到内置的 `deepseek-flash` 一行，所以官方改小版本号不会让价格突然消失。 记账是本地且廉价的，查询供应商要出门、可能被限流，所以两者有各自独立的开关和周期：关掉 `probeEnabled` 之后用量照常统计，只是余额与套餐不再刷新。 提醒判定用的是「**低于**」：余额刚好等于阈值、或窗口刚好还剩阈值那么多，都**不算**命中。提醒也只在真的有数字可读时出现 —— 没有凭据、查不到余额、窗口没有百分比的供应商不会被点红点。 超出范围的值会被夹到边界，不认识的键会被忽略，手改文件不会把插件弄进界面表达不出的状态。 ## 数据放在哪 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/usage.json` | 用量账本 | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/providers.json` | 余额与套餐快照 | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/upstream.json` | 抓到的价目表与节假日表（抓不到就用内置的） | | `$DSH_HOME/usage-stat/config.json` | 配置 | 账本**刻意不设时间与体积上限**。一天一个日期桶在 1 KB 量级，一年也就几百 KB，而任何「只保留 N 天」「超过 N KB 就删」的规则都只会在某一天悄悄丢掉你本来看得到的历史。唯一剩下的上限是会话行的条数（5000），那是防止文件被跑坏的兜底，不是预算。 供应商的 API Key 由 DSH 自己的凭据服务保管，只被宿主端读取，**不会进入浏览器**。 ## 已知限制 - **历史补录只能补回 DSH 日志还在的会话**：日志被删掉的、或在别的工作区里已经清掉的，补不回来。没有序号的事件会被跳过 —— 一个无法与已计过的调用区分开的事件，宁可漏记也不重复计数。补录是一次性的书签，不是持续订阅：日志在插件运行期间仍在增长，那部分由实时事件负责。 - **余额与套餐只覆盖已知端点的供应商**（余额 9 条路由、套餐 8 条）。其余供应商会写「该供应商没有提供这项数据」，不会用本地 token 数折算成钱。 - **余额需要能读到的 API Key**。用账号登录的供应商（例如桌面端的 DeepSeek 账号）不一定提供开放平台的余额接口，界面会如实说明。 - **金额是标准价折算，不是账单**：不含折扣、套餐与中转站的加价。内置价是官方**空闲时段**价，工作日 9:00-12:00 与 14:00-18:00 按两倍计；峰谷判定用**本机时区**，法定节假日表来自公开日历，国务院尚未公布的年份按普通工作日算。缓存写没有单独给价时按 0 计，没有价格的模型只报告、不计入合计。 - **图表最多回溯 366 天**：`全部` 或跨年窗口里，每日柱状图只画最近 366 天，轴上的日期只到月-日，所以更早的部分既看不到也不显示。 - **余量提醒是界面上的标记，不是系统通知**：它只出现在左下角卡片与账户页，不会弹窗、不发声。 - **「本次对话」的分供应商明细只对启用之后的对话有效**：更早的对话只留下总量，这时面板会写明「只有总量记录」，而不是把总量算到某个供应商头上。 - **界面文案是插件自带的 zh/en 两套**，按浏览器语言选一次，不跟随 DSH 设置里切换语言。 - 侧边栏卡片依赖 DSH 侧边栏的 DOM 结构，落位失败会退化成「追加到侧边栏底部」，不会崩 —— 这是 DOM 注入的固有代价。 ## 许可证与来源 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 界面布局的灵感来自 [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web)（Apache-2.0）。 ## 开发 面向维护者的内容 —— 数据来源与折叠语义、HTTP 接口、代码结构、设计取舍、测试与预览台、回退与升级路径 —— 都在 [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md)。

# 大肥鱼识屏 · DSH 桌宠插件

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的桌面桌宠 **dsh-pet** 加上「识屏模式」：桌面上的大肥鱼会定时看一眼你的屏幕，主动吐槽，也能看着屏幕跟你聊天。

> 两个插件**配套使用**：只装 `pet-menu` 菜单会出来但点了没反应；只装 `screensense` 就没有右键入口。

| 插件 | 版本 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`dafeiyu-screensense`](./dafeiyu-screensense) | 1.1.0 | 识屏本体：定时截屏、画面变化检测、主动吐槽、看着屏幕聊天 |
| [`dafeiyu-pet-menu`](./dafeiyu-pet-menu) | 1.0.0 | 给桌面右键菜单加「识屏模式」入口（开启 / 关闭 / 识别间隔） |

## 特性

- **定时识屏**：默认每 30 秒截一张主屏，缩到 1280 宽 JPEG。
- **不瞎说话**：8×8 均值哈希比较画面，画面没变化就静默，**零模型调用、零 token**。
- **主动吐槽**：画面变化时把截图交给当前模型，用大肥鱼的口吻说一句（≤60 字），气泡显示在桌宠上。
- **看着屏幕聊天**：`/fish <消息>` 让大肥鱼结合当前画面回你。
- **右键菜单**：识屏模式 → 开启识屏 / 关闭识屏 / 识别间隔（15 / 30 / 60 / 120 秒），开和关都会用气泡回话。
- **两端同步**：走 dsh-pet 的 `POST /dsh-pet-7340/broadcast`，浏览器 overlay 和桌面小窗看到同一份内容。

## 环境要求

- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），桌面模式可正常显示桌宠。
- 已安装 **dsh-pet 0.3.x**（只在 0.3.7 上验证过）。
- Windows：截屏脚本依赖 PowerShell 的 `System.Windows.Forms` + `System.Drawing`。

## 安装

### 方式一：Release 安装包（推荐）

1. 到 [Releases](../../releases) 下载最新的 `dafeiyu-dsh-plugins-v*.zip`，解压到**不带中文的路径**。
2. 在 DSH 里对 AI 说：

   > 用 plugin_manager install_bundle 安装这两个目录：
   > `<解压目录>\dafeiyu-screensense`
   > `<解压目录>\dafeiyu-pet-menu`

3. 安装需要完全访问权限，会弹一次批准；装完 `dafeiyu-pet-menu` 会自动重启桌面助手。
4. 若菜单没出现：右键大肥鱼 →「重载配置」。

### 方式二：从源码目录安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins.git
cd dafeiyu-dsh-plugins
npm pack --pack-destination dist ./dafeiyu-screensense
npm pack --pack-destination dist ./dafeiyu-pet-menu
```

然后同样用 `install_bundle` 指向上面的两个目录，或用 `dsh plugin add` 安装生成的 `.tgz`。

## 使用

右键桌面大肥鱼：「回到初始位置」下面会出现 **识屏模式**：

- **开启识屏** → 气泡回「识屏模式：开啦！我盯着你的屏幕咯～」
- **关闭识屏** → 气泡回「识屏模式：关啦，我先眯一会儿～」
- **识别间隔** → 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 秒

命令：

| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `/fish <消息>` | 结合当前屏幕画面聊天 |
| `/fish_look` | 立刻看一眼屏幕 |
| `/fish_screen on` / `off` | 开 / 关识屏 |
| `/fish_screen <秒数>` | 改间隔（≥10 秒） |
| `/fish_screen status` | 查看当前状态 |

HTTP 接口：

- `GET /dafeiyu-screensense/status` —— 当前开关、间隔、上次截图时间等
- `POST /dafeiyu-screensense/control` —— 开 / 关 / 改间隔（右键菜单就是调它）

## 配置（`dafeiyu-screensense`）

写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 里，改完重载该插件行即生效。

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 是否启用识屏 |
| `intervalSec` | `30` | 截屏间隔（秒） |
| `idleRepeatSec` | `120` | 画面不变时，隔多久允许再主动说一句 |
| `changeThreshold` | `6` | 哈希差异阈值，越大越不敏感 |
| `maxWidth` | `1280` | 截图缩放后的宽度 |
| `jpegQuality` | `72` | JPEG 质量 |
| `maxChars` | `60` | 单次吐槽最大字数 |
| `chatMemoryRounds` | `6` | `/fish` 聊天保留的上下文轮数 |
| `firstLookDelaySec` | `8` | 开启后首次截屏的延迟 |
| `provider` / `model` | 空 | 留空则跟随当前会话的默认模型 |
| `petId` | 空 | 指定桌宠实例，一般留空 |

`dafeiyu-pet-menu` 只有一个开关：`enabled`。

## 隐私与费用

- **截图会发给你当前选择的模型服务商**（截图作为图片消息随请求发出），只在开启识屏时发生。
- 画面没变化时不会调用模型，不会产生 token 消耗。
- 介意隐私的话，别在开着识屏时处理敏感内容，或直接把间隔调大 / 关掉。

## 兼容性与风险

`dafeiyu-pet-menu` 是**补丁插件**：dsh-pet 没提供右键菜单扩展接口，所以它会：

1. 找到 `node_modules/dsh-pet/runtime/electron-helper/renderer.js`；
2. 首次修改前备份为 `renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak`；
3. 追加带 `dafeiyu-pet-menu v1` 标记的 IIFE 补丁。

补丁是幂等的（已有标记就跳过）。**dsh-pet 升级后补丁可能被覆盖**，重装或重启本插件会自动补回。菜单依赖 dsh-pet 0.3.x 的 shared-core 实现，大版本升级后菜单可能不出现，但不会弄坏宠物。

## 卸载

1. 在 DSH 插件管理里停用 / 移除 `dafeiyu-pet-menu` 和 `dafeiyu-screensense`。
2. 想彻底还原右键菜单：把 `renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak` 覆盖回 `renderer.js`，再「重载配置」。

## 开发

```bash
npm pack --pack-destination dist ./dafeiyu-screensense
npm pack --pack-destination dist ./dafeiyu-pet-menu
```

两个包都带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，装进 profile 后由 DSH 的插件管理器加载。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skills-mcp

**在 DSH Web 设置页和模型工具里，统一管理系统级 / 项目级的 Skills 与 MCP 服务器。**

![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2%20~%200.2.x-4c6ef5)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%E2%89%A522.19-339933?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](#安装)
[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-43%20passed-2ea043)](#开发)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)插件：在 **Settings → Skills 与 MCP** 里对Skills和MCP进行统一管理，同时给模型两个对应工具 `skills_manager` / `mcp_manager`。

---

## 功能

| 能力         | 系统级                                                                                 | 项目级                                                         |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Skills 目录  | `$DSH_HOME/skills` + `$AGENTS_HOME/skills`（默认 `~/.dsh/skills`、`~/.agents/skills`） | `<project>/.dsh/skills` + `<project>/.agents/skills`           |
| MCP 配置文件 | `$DSH_HOME/mcp.json` + 外部 `~/.claude.json`                                           | `<project>/.dsh/mcp.json` + 外部 Claude 项目配置 / `.mcp.json` |
| 作用范围     | 所有会话                                                                               | 仅项目根匹配的会话                                             |
| 加载方式     | 插件全局挂载                                                                           | 每个 Agent 的 Cordis scope 内挂载                              |
| 生效方式     | 保存后立即重载                                                                         | 保存后重载活动会话；新会话创建前加载                           |

**Skills**

- 合并展示 DSH 与 Shared Agents 两个根目录的技能，行上标记来源；同名技能在两个根下可以分别存在。
- 新建 / 编辑完整 `SKILL.md` 时可以选择保存到哪个根目录，编辑器会校验 frontmatter。
- **在 DSH 中停用 / 启用**：只写状态文件，不动源文件、不影响其他 Agent。
- 删除进回收站，可恢复。

**MCP**

- DSH 管理的服务器与从 Claude Code 发现的外部服务器同页展示，按「DSH 管理 / Claude Code 发现 / 其他 Claude 项目」分组。
- 外部条目**默认已在 DSH 启用**，可单独停用；也可以一键「导入」为 DSH 管理的 `mcp.json` 条目后自由编辑。
- 支持 `stdio` 与 `streamable-http`，含 `env` / `headers` / `cwd` / `toolCallTimeoutMs`。
- 外部卡片的密钥不会出现在 WebUI 快照或模型工具输出里。

**页面布局**

- 顶部是作用域与项目上下文（只有项目级才显示项目选择器和完整路径）。
- 下方是带计数的 Skills / MCP 页签、搜索框与行内操作。
- 新建 / 编辑会切换到聚焦编辑器，不再把长表单挤在列表上方。

## 安装

前置条件：Node.js ≥ 22.19，且已经装好 `dsh` 命令行。

### 方式一：本地源码（开发调试，推荐用于改代码）

```bash
cd /path/to/dsh-skills-mcp
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build

# 本地开发必须用 link:（profile 使用 hoisted linker，file: 是安装时快照）
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-skills-mcp
```

### 方式二：GitHub

仓库已提交构建产物（`dist/`），因此 Git 源安装**不需要**在本地跑构建脚本，不会触发 `git-hosted plugins build on install` 的拦截。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:BrokenDreamStar/dsh-skills-mcp
```

### 验证安装

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 'id: dsh-skills-mcp'
```

## Skills

### 文件格式

支持两种形式，与 DSH 原生 provider 一致：

- 目录 bundle：`<name>/SKILL.md`
- 单文件：`<name>.md`

扫描的根目录（DSH 原生 provider 的同一组）：

| 来源          | 系统级                | 项目级                     |
| ------------- | --------------------- | -------------------------- |
| DSH           | `$DSH_HOME/skills`    | `<project>/.dsh/skills`    |
| Shared Agents | `$AGENTS_HOME/skills` | `<project>/.agents/skills` |

`$AGENTS_HOME` 默认为 `~/.agents`，可用环境变量覆盖。DSH 根的 `.system` 子目录不会纳入管理；指向根目录外的符号链接技能会列出并显示为**只读**，编辑和删除会被拒绝。

`SKILL.md` 必须以 YAML frontmatter 开头，至少包含：

```markdown
---
name: my-skill
description: 这个技能做什么、何时使用。
whenToUse: 可选，补充触发场景。
---

# My Skill

正文……
```

可选的调用控制与 DSH 一致：

```yaml
disable-model-invocation: true # 模型不可调用
user-invocable: false # 用户不能用 /name 调用
```

管理页会校验 frontmatter 并拒绝保存无效文件；已损坏的文件仍会列出来并标记问题，便于修复。

### 在 DSH 中启用 / 停用

每张技能卡都有 **在 DSH 停用 / 启用** 按钮。停用**不移动、不改写源文件**：插件会为活动 Agent 在 agent scope 注册一个同名、不可调用的 runtime skill，遮蔽文件系统 provider 的真实技能；新会话创建时同样应用。源目录、frontmatter 与其他 Agent（Claude Code、Codex 等）完全不受影响。

- 停用状态按 CWD 的项目根记录在 `$DSH_HOME/skills-mcp-state.json`。
- 系统级停用对所有会话生效；项目级只对匹配项目根的会话生效。
- 同名技能按“技能名”停用；再次启用后恢复原有可见性。
- 删除则是另一件事：移到 `$DSH_HOME/.skills-mcp-trash/<root-id>/<timestamp>-<name>`。

### 原生发现

管理页只负责写文件。让 Agent 看见技能仍需要 profile / preset 启用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`（由 `skill-filesystem` provider 扫描上述根目录）。在 dsh 0.2.1 的 Web preset 组合中，本地 skill-filesystem 由 agent preset 提供。

## MCP

### 配置文件格式

```json
{
	"mcpServers": {
		"filesystem": {
			"transport": "stdio",
			"command": "npx",
			"args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/path"],
			"env": { "TOKEN": "..." },
			"cwd": "/optional/cwd",
			"toolCallTimeoutMs": 60000
		},
		"remote": {
			"transport": "streamable-http",
			"url": "https://example.com/mcp",
			"headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ..." }
		},
		"disabled-server": {
			"transport": "stdio",
			"command": "node",
			"args": ["server.js"],
			"disabled": true
		}
	}
}
```

- `transport` 也接受 `type`，HTTP 别名 `http`。
- 项目级 stdio 未填 `cwd` 时默认使用项目根；系统级默认交给官方 client（空 cwd）。
- 未识别的条目字段会原样保留；顶层 `mcpServers` 之外的内容也会保留。
- 保存前自动写 `mcp.json.bak`，新文件权限为 `0600`。
- 同一作用域内 `serverName` 必须唯一；项目级与系统级同名会拒绝加载项目级条目。

### 加载与状态

- **系统级**：插件启动后异步挂载到全局工具层。加载失败的服务器会显示错误，不影响其他服务器。
- **项目级**：每个 Agent 创建（含恢复）时，根据会话 `cwd` 找到最近的 `.git` 根；若存在 `.dsh/mcp.json`，在 `agent.ctx` 里挂载官方 MCP client，因此工具只对该会话可见。多个活动会话各自持有连接和子进程，这是项目隔离的直接代价。
- 保存 MCP 配置会立即重载；外部手改文件后点“重载 MCP”或新建会话。
- 状态是 **加载状态 + 已注册工具数**，不是实时连接的健康检查：官方 client 当前不提供公开的连接状态 seam。挂载失败会显示错误；挂载成功后的断线由官方 client 的自动重连处理。
- 为保证错误可见，本插件挂载时设置 `failOnStartupError: true`。初次连接失败会显示错误并停止该实例；修正配置后点“重载 MCP”即可重试。成功挂载后的自动重连仍遵循官方 client 行为。

### Claude Code 外部 MCP 发现

插件会只读扫描：

- `~/.claude.json` 的全局 `mcpServers`
- `~/.claude.json` 中与当前项目根匹配的 `projects[<path>].mcpServers`
- 项目根下的 `.mcp.json`
- 系统级额外扫描其它项目的 `projects[<path>].mcpServers`，仅作为“可导入”候选

外部服务器卡片标记 **Claude Code / 来源只读**，不会修改 Claude Code 配置。它们默认**已在 DSH 启用**：插件启动时通过官方 client 加载，并把显式停用的 id 写入 `$DSH_HOME/mcp-external.json`（只存 id，不存 URL / env / header 密钥）。“在 DSH 禁用”只影响 DSH，Claude Code 继续使用原配置。旧版 `{ enabled: [...] }` 状态文件会按 allowlist 兼容读取，下一次启停时迁移为 v2 的 `disabled` 列表。

系统级页面还会列出**其它 Claude 项目**的 MCP 作为“可导入”候选（这些条目不会在当前作用域自动加载）。点“导入”会把它的 URL / command / env / headers（可能含密钥）复制到当前作用域的 `mcp.json`，成为可编辑 / 删除的 DSH 条目；同名 DSH 条目存在时拒绝覆盖。外部卡片的密钥不会出现在 WebUI 快照或模型工具的列表输出中；导入后的条目与普通 DSH 条目一样，其 headers / env 会在编辑表单中显示（文件本身是 0600 权限）。

导入或手工添加同名 managed 条目时，插件会先卸载已挂载的外部实例，再由 managed 条目接管，避免 `mcp-client` 的 `serverName` 冲突。managed 条目（即使已停用）按名字遮蔽外部条目；删除 managed 条目后，外部条目会重新按默认策略加载。

外部配置更新后，系统级点“重载 MCP”重新发现；项目级点“重载 MCP”或新建会话时重新读取。Claude Code 插件缓存目录里的 `.mcp.json` 不属于当前发现范围（`~/.claude.json` 与项目 `.mcp.json` 中已有的服务器会发现）。

### OAuth / 密钥

当前只支持直接 headers（适合 API key / Bearer token），不实现 OAuth 流程。`mcp.json` 中的 env / header 值是明文；请限制文件权限，不要把带密钥的配置提交到仓库。

## 模型工具

模型侧有两个工具，能力与设置页对齐：

- `skills_manager`：`list` / `read` / `save` / `delete` / `enable` / `disable`
- `mcp_manager`：`list` / `save` / `delete` / `enable` / `disable` / `reload` / `enable_external` / `disable_external` / `import_external`（外部 id 来自 `list`）

两个工具都接受 `scope: "system" | "project"` 与可选 `project`；项目级默认取调用会话的 cwd。

`list` / `read` 之外的写操作与官方 `plugin_manager` 一样要求当前的 `danger-full-access`，否则会在每次调用前请求审批；审批渠道不可用时拒绝执行。这样普通工作区会话无法借管理工具修改宿主配置。

## 架构

```text
WebUI (settings.section)
      │ POST /api/dsh-skills-mcp（connection.fetch 鉴权）
      ▼
ManagerService ── SkillsStore ──> ~/.dsh/skills | ~/.agents/skills | <project>/{.dsh,.agents}/skills
      │             └─ SkillStateStore → agent-scoped runtime shadows
      │
      └── McpRuntime
            ├─ 系统级：插件 ctx.plugin(@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client)
            ├─ 外部：ExternalMcpManager (Claude Code) + mcp-external.json
            └─ 项目级：agent/created → agent.ctx.plugin(...)
```

| 文件                   | 作用                                                    |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/index.ts`         | 插件入口：注册工具、API、生命周期                       |
| `src/service.ts`       | 组合层，快照与跨 host/tool 的操作                       |
| `src/skills.ts`        | Skills 扫描、frontmatter 校验、CRUD、回收站             |
| `src/skill-state.ts`   | DSH-only 技能启停状态（按系统 / 项目根存储）            |
| `src/skill-runtime.ts` | 在 Agent 作用域注册 runtime 遮蔽技能                    |
| `src/mcp-config.ts`    | `mcp.json` 读取 / 校验 / 原子写入，官方 client 配

plugins.description: 把磁盘扫成一张可批注的提案：Agent 标注、你来决定、删前可预览（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-disk-canvas

> 把磁盘扫成一张可批注的提案：Agent 标注、你来决定、删前可预览。（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

你在 Finder / SpaceSniffer 里能看到「哪个文件夹最大」，但看不到「它是什么、删了会怎样」。
这个插件把磁盘变成一张**画布**：每个方块按体积占位、按风险上色，点开有判断和依据；
你的决定（保留 / 待清理 / 待复查）直接标在方块上，汇总成一份可导出的计划。

![磁盘画布：左树图、右检查器](docs/screenshot.jpg)

同一个目录的两种镜头：树图看「哪里大」，列表逐项过——[列表视图](docs/screenshot-list.jpg)
把画布上小到不足 1 像素的项也全列出来，可以勾选后一次处理。

**它不删文件。** v0 只做分析与预览，执行权始终在你手里。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:vlln/dsh-disk-canvas
```

装完刷新页面。升级：把上面的 `add` 换成 `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-disk-canvas`。

- **画布入口**：会话页签里的 **磁盘画布**（与「对话」「轨迹」并排）。
- **整理模式**：新建任务时在模式选择器里选 **磁盘整理**——这个 preset 自带提示词与
  `disk_canvas_*` 工具，其它模式看不到这些工具。
- **前置**：macOS + dsh `0.2.1-rc.1` 或兼容的 0.2.x。

## 两种用法

| 用法 | 入口 | 你能做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 看与批注 | 任意会话 → **磁盘画布** 页签 | 树图、检视器、保留/待清理/待复查、预览、导出 |
| 让 Agent 参与 | 新建任务 → 模式选 **磁盘整理** | Agent 用 `disk_canvas_scan` / `state` / `claim` 扫描与标注，你在画布上改 |

页签与工具是分开的：画布在哪种模式都能打开（它只是数据视图），工具只在「磁盘整理」模式下挂载。

## 用起来

| 你做什么 | 画布给你什么 |
|---|---|
| 打开「磁盘画布」页签 | 主目录的第一层，按体积排的树图；左侧色条 = 风险（安全 / 谨慎 / 个人 / 未知 / 高危），标题行右侧是图例与各档数量 |
| 点一个方块 | 右侧检查器：这是什么、为什么、依据与把握、体积 / 占比 / 文件数 / 最近改动 |
| **在画布上拖一个框** | 框里的方块一起选中（⇧/⌘ 点方块是逐个加选），底部浮出批量条：几项、多少 GB、含几个个人内容 / 谨慎项 |
| **点批量条上的决定** | 一次给这十几项写同一个决定；比逐个点快一个数量级 |
| **点右上角列表图标** | 换成列表视图：76 项全在，包括画布上小到点不到的 42 项；行首复选框可以多选，表头复选框是全选；窗口窄了自动收起风险/占比列 |
| **点「按规则选」** | 一键选中「安全 / 谨慎 / 个人 / 未知 / 未审 / 已标待清理」整档（只作用于当前这一层），再走批量条 |
| **点右上角第三个图标（跨层索引）** | 扫描时顺带记下的「按名字可清理」的目录：node_modules / Caches / dist·build·target / __pycache__·.venv / Logs / .Trash / DerivedData。按类分组，显示处数与合计，整组勾选后直接批量决定 |
| **双击索引里的一行** | 跳到那一层：扫它的父目录、选中它，并切回树图（检查器里也有「在画布中定位」） |
| **点第四个图标（隔离区）** | 看清理脚本移走了什么：按批次列出原路径与体积、放了几天，可以**逐项或整批移回原位** |
| 计划条上的「隔离区 N 项」 | 常驻入口：跑完脚本后不用去找视图，直接看到移走了多少；超过 30 天的批次会变成琥珀色并提醒清空废纸篓 |
| **在画布上滚轮** | 以指针为锚点放大到 6 倍，文字不跟着变大（放大后更多小方块会显示名字）；`Alt`+拖 或 中键拖 平移，`0` 或右下角百分比复位 |
| 双击目录方块 | 进入该目录（方块放大铺满画布，再淡出成新一层） |
| 标一个决定 | 保留 / 待清理 / 待复查 + 一句备注；方块立刻变样（绿框 ✓ / 红底 ✕ / 黄虚线 ?） |
| 不选任何方块 | 检查器变成总览：审查进度、四档计数、按体积排的待审队列（点一行直接选中） |
| 点「预览清理后」 | 隐藏待清理块，看剩下的结构；**磁盘没有任何改动** |
| **在索引里搜路径** | 输入 `project` / `node_modules`，只留下匹配的目录（分组自动展开，组头数字跟着变成匹配数） |
| 点「导出」 | 三个产物：**清单**（Markdown，汇总 + 三张按决定分组的表，给人看）、**清理脚本**（`sh`，默认演练）、**JSON**（机器格式） |

备注**边写边存**（600ms 防抖），换方块也会先把没落盘的字写掉。右上角的检查器按钮可以收起，
收起后画布占满整宽——只想想看清楚结构的时候用它。

多选时按空格 / K / D / U 会把决定应用到**所有选中项**；Esc 是「取消选择」，不做返回——
返回交给面包屑和「向上」。

### 键盘

| 键 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| 空格 | 循环标记：无 → 待清理 → 保留 → 待复查 → 无（多选时作用于全部选中项） |
| K / D / U | 直接标：保留 / 待清理 / 待复查 |
| Backspace / 0 | 清掉选中项的决定 |
| ← ↑ ↓ → | 按方位在方块之间移动（列表视图里是上下移动） |
| Enter | 进入选中的目录 |
| Esc | 取消选择 / 取消正在拖的框选 |
| 0 | 缩放复位（100%） |

标记直接画在方块上：保留是绿框 + ✓，待清理是红底红框 + ✕，待复查是黄虚线 + ?。
悬停 220ms 出信息卡；左上角路径的每一段都可以点回去。
颜色只用来表达语义（风险与决定），按钮和界面本身一律中性色——不然「蓝色」到底是个人内容还是主按钮，自己也说不清。

## 定期扫描：两条路

- **插件内定时器**（齿轮菜单）：关 / 每天 / 每周，宿主进程按间隔重扫上一次的根。简单、不依赖会话，但 dsh 关着就不扫。
- **走 dsh 的定时提醒**：在「磁盘整理」模式下对 Agent 说「每周一扫一次」，它用 `schedule` 工具给当前会话
  定一个提醒；到点后提醒投递回这个会话，Agent 再跑一遍扫描并汇报增量。这种方式会真正启动一次会话，
  适合「想让我每周给你一份报告」而不是「只想让数据新鲜」。

两者不冲突：定时器管数据，提醒管汇报。

## 提案快照：把这份审查带走

齿轮菜单里的「提案快照」：

- **导出**：`disk-canvas-proposal.json` —— 你的决定、Agent 的判断、记住的规则（不含体积明细，很小）
- **导入**：只补本地没有的——已经做过的决定不覆盖、已有的规则不重复，导入后会告诉你
  「导入 N 条决定、M 条判断、K 条规则，跳过 J 条已有决定」

用途是**交接**：换台机器接着审、让同事在你看过的判断上继续、或者把一次审查的结论留档。

## 记住规则 / 自动扫描

右上角的齿轮：

- **自动扫描**：关 / 每天 / 每周。开着的时候宿主进程按间隔重扫上一次的根；
  启动时如果数据比间隔还旧，会补扫一次。**dsh 没开着就不会扫**——这不是常驻守护进程。
- **记忆规则**：在索引里选中一整类，批量条上勾「记住这类」再给决定，以后扫到同类目录自动这样标。
  规则只补「还没有人做过决定」的项，你手动改过的不会被覆盖；撤销规则时，会把它写下且你没改过的决定一起收回。

## 清理脚本：默认只演练

「导出 → 清理脚本」生成一个 `disk-cleanup.sh`：

- **不做 rm**：把待清理项 `mv` 到 `~/.Trash/dsh-disk-canvas-<时间戳>/` 下的隔离目录，
  并在里面写一份 `manifest.tsv`（名字 / 体积 / 原路径）——插件据此在「隔离区」视图里提供移回
- **默认演练**：直接 `sh disk-cleanup.sh` 只打印会移动什么；加 `--yes` 才真的移动
- 已经不在的路径会跳过并提示；`/` 和 `$HOME` 直接拒绝；路径里的引号会被正确转义
- 脚本里同时包含「当前层」和「索引里的其他层」的待清理项——和你导出的清单是同一批

这是 v0 第一次给出「执行面」，但仍然不碰删除：移动、可逆、默认不动。

## 持久化与历史

扫描快照、你的决定、Agent 的标注都写在 `$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-disk-canvas/ledger.json`：

- 每根目录保留**最近 20 次扫描 / 90 天 / 总量 ≤ 5 MB**（只存顶层聚合，不存整棵树）；
- 重启 dsh 后画布用上次快照**秒开**，不会先重扫；点「重新扫描」才更新；
- 标注按路径全局保留，换目录、换会话、重启都还在；
- `disk_canvas_history` 让 Agent 读历史与增量（"这周哪个目录在涨"）。

扫描是插件的持久周期，会话只是某次审查；关掉会话不影响账本。

## 能力面

**Preset**

| 模式 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 磁盘整理 | 自带提示词的磁盘审查 Agent：只分析、标注、预览；工具只有 `disk_canvas_*`，没有 shell / 删除能力 |

**Tools**（只挂在「磁盘整理」模式）

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `disk_canvas_scan` | 扫描一个目录（默认主目录）的直接子项，返回体积最大的若干项与规则标注 |
| `disk_canvas_state` | 读当前画布状态：计划、条目、你的决定 |
| `disk_canvas_claim` | 给某路径写一条判断（风险档 + 把握度），不执行删除 |
| `disk_canvas_history` | 读账本里的历史扫描与增量（最多 20 条） |

preset 里还有官方只读文件工具：`read` / `read_image`（`dsh-tool-fs` 关掉 write/edit）、
`glob` / `grep`（`dsh-tool-fs-search`）。**没有 shell、没有写/删工具**。

## 安全与数据

- **只读**：没有任何删除、移动、压缩接口；导出的计划由你自己执行。
- **本地**：扫描在宿主进程内完成，不发网络请求、不上传路径或清单。
- **落盘但只在本地**：扫描快照、决定与标注写在 `$DSH_HOME/data/dsh-disk-canvas/ledger.json`，不上传、不同步。
- **诚实**：没有证据的项标 `unknown`，不会把「不确定」包装成「安全」。
- **同源**：写面（scan / annotate）校验 `Origin` 与 `Host`，并限制请求体大小。

## 已知限制

- macOS 首版；Linux / Windows 未验证。
- 只扫当前一层（双击下钻）。首次扫描边扫边出（100 GB 级主目录约 15–60 秒），单个超大目录可能被条目/时间预算截断并标「部分结果」，不假装扫完。
- 不解析压缩包、虚拟机镜像、快照内部；容器只当普通文件。
- 「永久保留」目前是单次会话内的批注，不是跨会话规则（规则泛化在路线图上）。
- 规则推断基于路径与时间，不是文件内容；对未知目录保持沉默。
- 五档风险里 `personal`（个人内容）与 `unknown` 只是分类，不是「可删」；只有你标记的才算决定。
- 不提供回收站 / 隔离区 / 撤销——因为它们属于执行面，v0 刻意没有执行面。
- 历史只保留顶层聚合；要看更早的变化需要在账本上限内重扫。
- 画布面积严格等于体积：小项会小到不足 1 像素（真实主目录里 76 项有 42 项如此），
  树图上点不到——列表视图里全都有。这不是 bug，是单层树图对「少量大项 + 长尾小项」的诚实表现。
- **跨层索引是按目录名匹配的**（node_modules / Caches / dist / build / target / __pycache__ / .venv / Logs / .Trash / DerivedData），
  不是全量文件索引：同名但实际用途不同的目录会进索引（所以 build/target 那组标的是「谨慎」），
  反过来名字不在规则里的目录不会被收进来。每组最多展示前 200 条，合计仍按全部算。
- 规则可以在齿轮菜单里**导出 / 导入**（`disk-canvas-rules.json`），换台机器把习惯带走；导入是整体替换。
- 记忆规则按**目录名**生效，不是按路径：它会在每次扫描后给新出现的同类目录补一个决定（`by: rule`），
  所以规则开着的时候，扫描会顺带改写一批标注——这是「记住」的含义，撤销规则可以整体收回。
- 自动扫描依赖 dsh 进程活着；没有后台常驻，也没有系统级 launchd 定时器。
- 清理脚本只做「移动到废纸篓」，没有「恢复」按钮——恢复要靠废纸篓自己。
  隔离目录没有 30 天自动清理（产品文档里的目标形态），现在是手动的；插件也不会替你清空废纸篓。
- 移回原位时如果原位置已经有同名项，会拒绝并提示——先处理冲突再试。
- 扫描预算：每个直接子项 200 万条目 / 40 秒，全局 90 秒。预算定得太小会让同一个目录每次扫出不同体积
  （结果取决于 readdir 顺序），这条踩过坑——被截断的项在检查器里用 `≥` 标出来。
- 缩放是几何 + 语义两层：方块和间距按倍率放大，文字/内边距反向缩回去，所以看起来字号不变；
  上限 6 倍，不做动画补间。

## 兼容性

| dsh 版本 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.1` | ✅ 已验证（2026-10-18，真实安装并启动 web profile；页签、preset、工具注册） |
| 其它 0.2.x | ⚠️ 未验证——升级 dsh 后若页签消失，多半是 `conversation.view` 槽名或 preset 字段变了 |

## 插件管理

装/卸/启停用官方 CLI：`dsh plugin --profile web add|remove dsh-disk-canvas`；已装插件在
**侧边栏 Plugins 页**里查看与配置（Settings 里的「插件」只是只读清单）。

## 许可

MIT。交互契约见 [docs/contract.md](docs/contract.md)。

# dsh-control-center

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Three visual Settings pages for the DeepSeek Harness: **MCP servers**, **skills**
and **global personas**. One dual-face plugin — a host half that owns the data
and the one model-facing contribution, and a browser half that renders the
pages into the settings shell.

> The Chinese document ([README.zh.md](README.zh.md)) is the fuller one: it adds
> the verification log, troubleshooting, and the one-click script reference.

```
Settings
├── …
├── MCP 管理          MCP server CRUD
├── Skill 管理        author or pull skills, inspect and delete them
└── 全局人设          a library of persona documents, one active
```

## Install

The package is a normal DSH bundle. Any channel works.

**One script (Windows).** Copies the package, backs the patch up once, and
writes the marked mount block — idempotent, `-DryRun` to preview, `-Profile` /
`-DshHome` to target another profile:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\uninstall.ps1   # one-key restore
```

**Official CLI**, which also records the bundle in the profile manifest:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-control-center
```

**By hand**, for a profile whose `node_modules` is managed manually: copy this
directory to `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-control-center`, then append the mount
row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: control-center
      name: 'dsh-control-center'
```

`dsh-hmr` watches that file, so the plugin activates on save; the browser half
is part of the client boot graph and needs one page refresh the first time it
appears. After the first installation the script leaves
`cordis.patch.yml.bak-dsh-control-center` as the final rollback point.

## The three pages

### MCP 管理

An MCP server is a Loader row, not a settings value, so the page writes a
delimited **managed block** into the active profile's own patch layer and lets
`dsh-hmr` reload the composition:

```yaml
# >>> dsh-control-center:mcp — managed, edit it from Settings instead
- insert: [{"id":"cc-mcp-github","name":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client","config":{…}}]
# <<< dsh-control-center:mcp
```

Everything outside the two markers is preserved byte for byte, and the payload
is JSON — a strict subset of YAML 1.2 — so no URL, argument or environment value
can change the document's shape. The definitions live in
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/mcp-servers.json`; the block is regenerated from them
on every write, so disabling a server removes its row without losing it.

The row reports its live Loader state, so the list distinguishes *configured*,
*enabled* and *connected*.

### Skill 管理

Skills are ordinary files, so this page is a filesystem editor over the roots
`dsh-skill-filesystem` already scans — it keeps no database:

| Root | Source |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/skills` | `user-dsh`, provider rank 400 — where installs go |
| `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` | `user-agents`, rank 500 |
| any `customSkillDirs` | from a live `skill-filesystem` row |

Project roots (`.dsh/skills`, `.agents/skills`) depend on the session's working
directory rather than on this global page and are deliberately left out.

* **New skill** writes `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` with `name`, `description`,
  `whenToUse` and the body.
* **Raw editor** opens the current file verbatim; saving re-validates the
  frontmatter.
* **Pull from GitHub** downloads one source archive, finds every `SKILL.md` at a
  plausible depth, and installs each bundle. Three URL shapes are accepted, plus
  the `git@github.com:owner/repo.git` spelling:

  ```
  https://github.com/owner/repo
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>/<subpath>
  ```

  No `git` binary is needed: the archive is fetched from `codeload` and unpacked
  by a small built-in tar reader. An existing skill is only replaced when
  **overwrite** is on.

The filesystem provider watches its roots, so a created, edited or deleted skill
reaches the next model step without a restart.

### 全局人设

Each persona is a Markdown document under
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/personas/`, with its name and description in
`personas.json`. Exactly one is active, and the page can clear the seat.

The active document is registered as **one** system-prompt section:

```js
ctx.systemPrompt.section({
  name: 'control-center:persona',
  order: 5,
  text: activeDocument,
  interpolate: false,
})
```

Three properties follow, and all are intended:

* **additive** — the harness identity, the deployment persona, tool guidance and
  the environment suffix are untouched; the section lands immediately after the
  deployment persona prefix at order 0;
* **global** — a preset that shadows `deployment:persona-prefix` for one agent
  does not remove it, so every session is covered;
* **literal** — `interpolate: false` keeps `{{…}}` as written, so a stray brace
  in prose can never fail prompt assembly.

Switching the active document disposes and re-registers the section; the next
assembly carries the new text.

## HTTP API

One POST-only route, `/control-center/api`, with a `method` field:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `system.info` | paths and version |
| `mcp.state` / `mcp.save` / `mcp.remove` / `mcp.toggle` | MCP servers |
| `skill.state` / `skill.read` / `skill.save` / `skill.write` / `skill.remove` / `skill.pull` | skills |
| `persona.state` / `persona.read` / `persona.save` / `persona.remove` / `persona.activate` | personas |

Responses are `{ ok: true, value }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`.
The route is fenced against cross-origin browser callers: an `Origin` header must
name a loopback host, and a present `Content-Type` must be JSON. A caller with no
`Origin` — the Electron IPC bridge, a shell tool — is already running with the
user's own authority.

## Checks

Both scripts need no dependencies and no harness:

```bash
node scripts/selfcheck.mjs     # host half: frontmatter, tar, the managed block, all three stores over real files
node scripts/clientsmoke.mjs   # browser half: bundle, slot registration, every section rendered with stubbed host replies
```

`skill.pull`'s network path is not exercised by either; verify it against a real
repository from the running harness.

## Layout

```
index.js                 host half: route, API table, persona section, MCP reconciliation
client.js                browser half: the three Settings sections
lib/wire.js              body reader, JSON responder, request fence
lib/paths.js             DSH_HOME / profile locations, atomic read-write
lib/mcp.js               MCP store + the managed patch block
lib/skills.js            skill roots, frontmatter, CRUD, GitHub install
lib/github.js            repository reference parsing + archive download
lib/tar.js               minimal tar reader
lib/personas.js          persona store + the prompt section lifecycle
scripts/install.ps1      one-key install (UTF-8 with BOM — see README.zh.md)
scripts/uninstall.ps1    one-key restore
scripts/selfcheck.mjs    host-half checks
scripts/clientsmoke.mjs  browser-half checks
```

## Publishing to the DSH plugin market

`package.json` is already shaped for it (no `private`, `license`, `repository`
with `directory`, `keywords`, `engines.dsh`, `peerDependencies`,
`dsh.manifestVersion`) and `locale/{en,zh}.json` supplies the store card copy.

The catalog is the curated list [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin):
add ONE file under `data/plugins/`, run `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs`, open
a PR. The step-by-step checklist — plus the entry YAML, a pre-flight validator
and the screenshot template — lives in the repository's `publish/` directory.

# dsh-dd-forge — due-diligence document review (DeepSeek Harness plugin)

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

**Documents → rule packs → risk report**: feed the deterministic engine a due-diligence folder (registry / equity / financials / contracts / charters / employment contracts) and get a sourced risk report. Built for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/DeepSeek-AI/deepseek-harness); the engine (opcore) itself has zero dsh dependencies and runs standalone.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ dsh session (model + judgement)                  │
│   skills: dsh-dd-forge-review / -report          │  ← judgement layer (prompt skills)
│   tools:  dd_review / dd_rules                   │  ← deterministic layer (registered tools)
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ opcore engine (engine/, zero dsh deps)           │
│   loader (docs → facts) → rule execution → report │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ packs/ (YAML rule packs — data, not code)        │
│   general-company 12 · contract-basics 8         │
│   trade-contract 8 · trade-bulk 10               │
│   logistics 8 · labour 8 · credit-financials 8   │
│   guarantee 5 · corporate-charter 5              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-dd-forge
```

Local development: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-dd-forge` — pnpm `link:` installs do not auto-install dependencies, so run `npm install` in this directory first.

## Use

In a dsh session, hand a target folder to the model ("run a due-diligence review on ./target-company"), or call the tools directly:

- **`dd_review`** — run all rule packs over a folder (the `packs` parameter optionally narrows to a pack subset); returns findings and writes the report into the workspace (`reportPath` overrides the report location); the `format` parameter selects `md` / `docx` / `xlsx` (comma-separated, default `md`); the top-up loop parameters are `saveRun` (serialize this run into a re-runnable review.json snapshot) and `baseline` (diff against a previous snapshot — see "Top-up re-run loop"); pass a `targets` array to review several folders in one call (see "Batch review")
- **`dd_rules`** — list packs and every rule with severity, category, and public reference

Skills: `dsh-dd-forge-review` (folder conventions + verification discipline for high findings), `dsh-dd-forge-report` (writing the full DD report on top of engine output).

### Batch review (several folders)

To review several subjects in one session, `dd_review` takes a `targets` array (mutually exclusive with `target`): `targets=["./companyA","./companyB"]`. Each folder gets its own report set (exported per `format` as `<workspace>/dd-review-report-<company>.<ext>`; the folder name when no registry document names the subject; duplicates get `-2`/`-3` suffixes), plus one **summary index** at `<workspace>/dd-review-index.md` (`indexPath` overrides the location): a per-subject conclusion/stats table, a cross-subject high-severity quick view, totals, and relative links to every report — closed by the same disclaimer.

Every folder is validated up front (one inaccessible folder fails the whole call — no half delivery). `reportPath` / `saveRun` / `baseline` are single-run parameters and are rejected with `targets` — to take one folder through the top-up loop, call the tool with `target` for it alone.

### Folder conventions

The engine recognizes documents by filename patterns; anything missing simply leaves the corresponding rules as `missing_data`:

| Document | File | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registry | `工商信息.json` (or any json matching 工商/registry) | Chinese or English keys; capital in 万元 |
| Equity | `*股权*.csv` or `.xlsx` (filename/sheet matching 股权/股东) | header: 股东,认缴出资(万元),实缴出资(万元),持股比例(%),备注 |
| Financials | `*资产负债*.csv`, `*利润*.csv`, `*现金流量*.csv` (or same-named xlsx sheets) | accounts as rows, years as columns (`科目,2024,2023`), 万元 |
| Contracts | `contracts/*.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | one contract per file; optional frontmatter: 标题, 签订日期 |
| Charter | any `章程`-matching `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | extracts company name, registered capital, shareholder rows, mandatory items, share-transfer clause |
| Employment contract | any `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` whose filename contains 「劳动合同」 or whose body contains 「劳动合同期限」 | extracts contract term, probation months and its statutory tiered cap, probation/agreed salary, non-compete term and compensation, service period with training cost and penalty, mandatory items and rules-policy wording |

docx (contracts/charters) and xlsx (financials/equity) are parsed **natively** (mammoth/exceljs, lazily loaded — zero cost when absent). Only scans/images need in-session conversion first.

The loader also extracts clause facts from contract bodies for the specialized packs: **deposit amount and ratio** ("定金…N 元"), **advance amount and ratio** (amount form "预付款 N 元" or percent form "预付 N%", feeding the bulk-trade pack), **payment term days** ("N 日内付清/支付" — deadlines that pay a deposit/advance do not count; read by both the trade and logistics packs), **daily penalty rate** ("万分之X/日", auto-annualized), **trade-contract classification** (购销/买卖/采购/销售/供货/大宗商品/贸易 — bulk-trade rules report 不适用 on non-trade contracts), **logistics-contract classification** (货物运输/运输服务/承运/仓储/配送 — logistics rules report 不适用 on non-logistics contracts; a counterparty *named* 「物流」 does not classify a contract), plus 36 clause-presence probes (risk transfer, force majeure, notice, acceptance, exclusivity, third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-vs-penalty election, documents of title, auto-renewal, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related & dispute institution, cargo damage liability, insured/declared-value carriage, loading duties, subcontracting restrictions, POD & reconciliation, cargo claims, vehicle & driver qualifications, …).

Employment contracts are parsed as their own document type (they never enter the commercial-contract candidate set): **contract term in years** (date form 「劳动合同期限自 X 起至 Y 止」 first, stated years as fallback; open-ended contracts detected separately), **probation months with the statutory tiered cap** (Labour Contract Law art. 19 tiers: <3 months 0 / 3 months-1 year 1 / 1-3 years 2 / ≥3 years & open-ended 6), **probation vs agreed salary** (auto-derived 80%-line ratio), **non-compete term** (months/years normalized) **and compensation clause** (an explicit 「无需支付经济补偿」 waiver does not count as agreed), **service period with training cost and penalty**, plus art.-17 mandatory-item and rules-policy probes.

## Rule packs

Nine packs, 72 rules, each with a public reference (statute or an explicitly labelled convention threshold):

| Pack | Rules | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `general-company` | 12 | registry status, paid-in ratio, equity cross-checks, balance-sheet identity & solvency, guarantee resolutions |
| `contract-basics` | 8 | essential clauses, digit-vs-uppercase amounts, signing date and signature block |
| `trade-contract` | 8 | deposit cap (Civ. Code art. 586, 20%), payment term (90-day convention), risk transfer, force majeure, daily penalty annualized |
| `trade-bulk` | 10 | bulk-trade special: advance ratio (30% convention), third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-plus-penalty election (Civ. Code art. 588), force majeure excluding market swings, documents of title (仓单/提单), auto-renewal exit, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related dispute institution |
| `logistics` | 8 | logistics special: cargo damage/loss liability (Civ. Code art. 832), insured/declared-value carriage, freight payment term (60-day convention reading the same fact as TC-002's 90-day line — layered thresholds), loading duties, subcontracting restrictions (cf. art. 923), POD & reconciliation, cargo-claim procedure & deadline, vehicle & driver qualifications |
| `labour` | 8 | employment special: mandatory clauses (Labour Contract Law art. 17), probation tiered cap and 80% salary line (arts. 19/20), non-compete compensation and two-year cap (arts. 23/24), servi
